# The vulnerabilities that the govulncheck gate accepts (ADR-0040 item 3, .github/scripts/govulncheck-gate.py),
# one "<OSV id> <module>@<version> <reason>" per line. Every other vulnerability that the code of
# controller/ or ranz-bgp/ calls fails the Linux job of its workflow. An entry holds for that version of
# the module only.

# The advisory lists every version of GoBGP as affected and no fixed one. Its fix, commit 583080a
# ("server: fix malformed nexthop attribute crash", 2026-03-05, the FIX reference of the advisory), is in
# v4.10.0: GitHub's compare of the commit with the tag v4.10.0 is "ahead" by 395 commits, "behind" by 0.
GO-2026-4736 github.com/osrg/gobgp/v4@v4.10.0 the fix (commit 583080a) is in v4.10.0; the advisory records no fixed version

# The advisory (GHSA-9fw6-xgg2-mq9q, an OOM of the server "when the sniff is enabled") is of the sniff of
# Hysteria, a RequestHook of the server of the library (extras/v2/sniff in v2.13.0): it parsed the QUIC
# packets that an authenticated client sends over UDP, and a huge CRYPTO length made it allocate that
# much. The entry of the database is unreviewed and lists no symbol and no fixed version, so every
# function of core/v2 counts as reaching it; the reviewed GHSA records 2.8.1 as the last affected
# version, and the sniff of v2.13.0 assembles only the CRYPTO bytes that the packets hold. The Hysteria
# part of ranz mimic gives the library no RequestHook and DisableUDP, and no setting changes either
# (controller/internal/mimic/hysteriaserver.go:115-124, TestTheHysteriaListenerNeverTurnsOnTheSniff);
# the library reads the UDP of a client, the only way to the hook of UDP, only without DisableUDP
# (server/server.go:219 of core/v2 v2.13.0).
GO-2026-5288 github.com/apernet/hysteria/core/v2@v2.13.0 ranz mimic never sets the RequestHook of the sniff and carries no UDP (hysteriaserver.go:115-124); the reviewed GHSA records 2.8.1 as the last affected version
